::: {.home-intro}
::: {.home-intro-copy}
I serve as Assistant Secretary for Policy Analytics and Technical Assessment in
the Office of the Cabinet Secretary, Office of the President of the Philippines.
The Office of the Cabinet Secretary is tasked with monitoring the implementation
of government programmes and helping to ensure that public services reach the
people for whom they are intended.

I hold a BSc in Mathematics with First Class Honours from the [University of
Bristol](https://www.bristol.ac.uk/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} and am pursuing an MSc in Science,
Technology, Engineering and Public Policy at [University College London
(UCL)](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/prospective-students/graduate/taught-degrees/science-technology-engineering-and-public-policy-msc){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
through flexible distance learning.
:::

::: {.home-intro-photo}
![](assets/images/rey-joseph-nieto-portrait.jpg){.profile-photo fig-alt="Portrait of Rey Joseph RJ Nieto" width=824 height=824}
:::

## Teaching

I teach [*Mathematics in the Modern
World*](teaching/bulsu/math-modern-world/index.qmd) and [*Living in the IT
Era*](teaching/bulsu/living-it-era/index.qmd) part-time at [Bulacan State
University](https://bulsu.edu.ph/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}. My [teaching
materials](teaching/index.qmd) include original lecture notes, exercises, and
supplementary resources developed primarily for biology students.

## Writing

I write [*Calculated*](calculated/index.qmd), a weekly Saturday column for the
*Manila Bulletin*. The newspaper's [author
archive](https://mb.com.ph/author/rj-nieto){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
provides links to the published essays.

## Research

My [independent research](research/index.qmd) asks how image-analysis methods
respond when images are rotated, resized, poorly exposed, or degraded by sensor
noise, and whether those response patterns can help identify acquisition
problems. The work continues my University of Bristol dissertation,
*Computational Stability of Cubical Homology*; the
[thesis](https://github.com/reyjosephnieto/ph/blob/main/Nieto_TDA_Public_20260430.pdf){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
and [Python implementation](https://github.com/reyjosephnieto/ph){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
are publicly available.

## Earlier work

My earlier work spans technical writing, journalism, national broadcasting,
public affairs, government communications, and programme delivery. Further
details are available in my [CV](cv/index.qmd) and on
[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rjosephnieto/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}.
